items.title: Base change preserves the tor amplitude interval
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that base changing a complex of modules with tor amplitude in a given interval along a ring map produces a complex over the new ring with tor amplitude in the same interval. The proof uses the characterisation of tor amplitude by a complex of flat modules concentrated in the interval: a quasi-isomorphism from such a complex is chosen, the base changed complex computes the derived tensor product and has flat terms because base change of flat modules is flat, and the characterisation is applied again over the new ring.
